breakdowns.sentence: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. This episode is for upper intermediate and advanced English listeners. 2025 is coming to an end. So soon this year went by so fast.
breakdowns.translation: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。本集適合中高級和高級英語聽眾。 2025年即將結束。時間這麼快，這一年過得這麼快。

breakdowns.sentence: Learning from both the achievements and the failures, finding the beauty in every moment because that's.

points.label: that 子句
points.note: 補充說明前面的名詞或想法。

breakdowns.sentence: You could be an achievement for someone else. For instance, if I was doing a presentation in front of a group of people.
breakdowns.translation: 你可能會成為別人的成就。例如，如果我在一群人面前做演示。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用條件說明可能情況與結果。

breakdowns.sentence: I would get over my fear of public speaking. Now for someone else, the presentation went wrong.
breakdowns.translation: 我會克服對公開演講的恐懼。現在對於其他人來說，演示出了問題。

points.label: would 用法
points.note: 表示假設、過去習慣或委婉語氣。

breakdowns.sentence: It is. When I was younger.

points.label: when 時間子句
